mapper.select: select u.user_id userId,b.customer_id customerId,u.user_name userName,u.nick_name nickName, u.phonenumber,u.email,u.status,u.remark,u.create_time createTime from ndt_customer_user b join sys_user u on u.user_id=b.user_id and u.del_flag='0' where b.customer_id=#{customerId} order by u.user_id desc
select customer_id from ndt_customer_user where user_id=#{userId}

select b.customer_id from ndt_customer_user b join sys_user u on u.user_id=b.user_id and u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' join ndt_customer c on c.id=b.customer_id and c.del_flag='0' where b.user_id=#{userId} and exists(select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key='ndt_customer' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' where ur.user_id=b.user_id)
select exists(select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.role_key='ndt_customer' and r.del_flag='0')
